title: Amendment Notice
issuer: Government of Nepal, Ministry of Home Affairs, Armed Police Force, Nepal, Nepal A.P.F Hospital, Procurement Section, Balbabu, Kathmandu, Nepal
key_points: The notice amends the previous notification APFH/NCB/G/06/2083/084 regarding the supply, delivery, and installation of Anesthesia Relevant Equipments (Contract ID No. APFH/NCB/G/06/2083/084).
The deadline for submission of sealed bids has been changed to 12:00 Hrs on 14 Mansir 2083.
Bids must be accompanied by a bid security amounting to a minimum of 10% of the bid value, valid for 30 days.
The bid validity period has been extended to 30 days beyond the bid submission deadline.
The specifications for ABG Machine have been updated to include measurements like pH, pCO2, pO2, Hb, Barometric Pressure, Na+, K+, Ca++, Cl-, Bl, urea and SrCreatinine& Blood sugar.
